mapper.select:
SELECT
CONCAT(COALESCE(d.currency, ''), ':', )
AS group_key,
CONCAT(COALESCE(d.currency, ''), ' · ', )
AS group_label,
COALESCE(d.currency, '') 'percent' 'days' 'count' AS unit,
COALESCE(SUM(d.actual_value), 0) COALESCE(SUM(d.value), 0) COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.won = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0) COALESCE(AVG(DATEDIFF(d.closed_at, d.created_at)), 0) COUNT(*) AS value FROM deal d LEFT JOIN pipeline p ON p.id = d.pipeline_id AND p.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} LEFT JOIN stage s ON s.id = d.stage_id AND s.pipeline_id = d.pipeline_id AND s.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} LEFT JOIN company c ON c.id = d.company_id AND c.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} WHERE d.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId}
AND d.expected_close_date >= #{query.startDate} AND d.expected_close_date < #{query.endDateExclusive}
AND >= #{query.startUtc} AND < #{query.endUtc}
AND d.won = TRUE AND d.won IS NOT NULL AND d.won IS NULL
GROUP BY group_key, group_label, unit
ORDER BY MIN(d.pipeline_id), MIN(s.position), group_key ORDER BY group_key

mapper.select:
SELECT
COALESCE(CAST(person.company_id AS CHAR), 'unassigned') 'total' AS group_key,
COALESCE(company.name, 'Unassigned') 'Total' AS group_label, 'count' AS unit, COUNT(*) AS value FROM person LEFT JOIN company ON company.id = person.company_id AND company.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} WHERE person.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} AND person.created_at >= #{query.startUtc} AND person.created_at < #{query.endUtc}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person_tag pt JOIN tag filter_tag ON filter_tag.id = pt.tag_id AND filter_tag.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} WHERE pt.person_id = person.id AND pt.tag_id IN #{id})
GROUP BY group_key, group_label ORDER BY group_key

SELECT
COALESCE(NULLIF(company.industry, ''), 'Unspecified') 'total' AS group_key,
COALESCE(NULLIF(company.industry, ''), 'Unspecified') 'Total' AS group_label, 'count' AS unit, COUNT(*) AS value FROM company WHERE company.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} AND company.created_at >= #{query.startUtc} AND company.created_at < #{query.endUtc}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM company_tag ct JOIN tag filter_tag ON filter_tag.id = ct.tag_id AND filter_tag.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} WHERE ct.company_id = company.id AND ct.tag_id IN #{id})
GROUP BY group_key, group_label ORDER BY group_key

SELECT AS group_key, AS group_label,
'percent' 'count' AS unit,
COALESCE(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN dd.status = 'final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0)
COUNT(*) AS value FROM deal_document dd JOIN deal d ON d.workspace_id = dd.workspace_id AND d.id = dd.deal_id LEFT JOIN company c ON c.id = d.company_id AND c.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} WHERE dd.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} AND d.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} AND dd.type = 'quote' AND dd.generated_at >= #{query.startUtc} AND dd.generated_at < #{query.endUtc}
GROUP BY group_key, group_label, unit ORDER BY group_key

SELECT AS group_key, AS group_label,
'days' 'count' AS unit,
COALESCE(ROUND( AVG(GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, a.created_at, a.decided_at), 0)) / 86400, 2), 0)
COUNT(*) AS value FROM document_approval a JOIN deal d ON d.workspace_id = a.workspace_id AND d.id = a.deal_id LEFT JOIN company c ON c.id = d.company_id AND c.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} WHERE a.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} AND d.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} AND a.status IN ('approved', 'rejected') AND a.decided_at >= #{query.startUtc} AND a.decided_at < #{query.endUtc}
GROUP BY group_key, group_label, unit ORDER BY group_key

SELECT
CONCAT(COALESCE(open_deal.currency, ''), ':',
CAST(gap_company.id AS CHAR) 'total' )
CAST(gap_company.id AS CHAR) 'total' AS group_key,
CONCAT(COALESCE(open_deal.currency, ''), ' · ',
gap_company.name 'Total' )
gap_company.name 'Total' AS group_label,
COALESCE(open_deal.currency, '') 'count' AS unit,
COALESCE(SUM(open_deal.value), 0) COUNT(DISTINCT gap_company.id) AS value FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.name FROM company c LEFT JOIN person gap_person ON gap_person.company_id = c.id AND gap_person.created_at < #{query.endUtc} AND gap_person.suspended_at IS NULL AND gap_person.archived_at IS NULL AND ( gap_person.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM person_share gap_person_share JOIN workspace gap_person_viewer ON gap_person_viewer.id = gap_person_share.workspace_id AND gap_person_viewer.id = #{query.workspaceId} JOIN workspace gap_person_owner ON gap_person_owner.id = gap_person.workspace_id AND gap_person_owner.org_id = gap_person_viewer.org_id WHERE gap_person_share.person_id = gap_person.id AND gap_person_share.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} AND gap_person_share.created_at < #{query.endUtc} ) ) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT warmth_touch.person_id, SUM(warmth_touch.weight * POW(#{model.decayBase}, -warmth_touch.age_days / #{model.halfLifeDays})) AS raw_weight FROM ( SELECT a.person_id, CASE LOWER(a.type) WHEN 'meeting' THEN #{model.meetingWeight} WHEN 'call' THEN #{model.callWeight} WHEN 'email' THEN #{model.emailWeight} ELSE #{model.otherActivityWeight} END AS weight, GREATEST(0.0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, a.timestamp, #{warmthReference}) / #{model.microsecondsPerDay}) AS age_days FROM activity a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} AND a.person_id IS NOT NULL AND a.timestamp < #{query.endUtc} UNION ALL SELECT n.person_id, #{model.noteWeight} AS weight, GREATEST(0.0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, n.created_at, #{warmthReference}) / #{model.microsecondsPerDay}) AS age_days FROM note n WHERE n.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} AND n.visibility = 'workspace' AND n.person_id IS NOT NULL AND n.created_at < #{query.endUtc} UNION ALL SELECT t.person_id, #{model.taskWeight} AS weight, GREATEST(0.0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, t.created_at, #{warmthReference}) / #{model.microsecondsPerDay}) AS age_days FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} AND t.person_id IS NOT NULL AND t.created_at < #{query.endUtc} ) warmth_touch GROUP BY warmth_touch.person_id ) person_warmth ON person_warmth.person_id = gap_person.id WHERE c.created_at < #{query.endUtc} AND ( c.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM company_share gap_company_share JOIN workspace gap_company_viewer ON gap_company_viewer.id = gap_company_share.workspace_id AND gap_company_viewer.id = #{query.workspaceId} JOIN workspace gap_company_owner ON gap_company_owner.id = c.workspace_id AND gap_company_owner.org_id = gap_company_viewer.org_id WHERE gap_company_share.company_id = c.id AND gap_company_share.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} AND gap_company_share.created_at < #{query.endUtc} ) ) AND c.archived_at IS NULL
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM company_tag coverage_company_tag JOIN tag coverage_tag ON coverage_tag.id = coverage_company_tag.tag_id AND coverage_tag.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} WHERE coverage_company_tag.company_id = c.id AND coverage_company_tag.tag_id IN #{id} )
GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN COALESCE(person_warmth.raw_weight, 0.0) >= #{model.warmMinimumRawWeight} THEN gap_person.id ELSE NULL END) <= 1 ) gap_company LEFT JOIN deal open_deal ON open_deal.company_id = gap_company.id AND open_deal.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} AND open_deal.won IS NULL
AND open_deal.pipeline_id IN #{id}
AND open_deal.owner_id IN #{id}
AND 'open' IN #{status}
WHERE open_deal.id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY group_key, group_label, unit ORDER BY value DESC, group_label, group_key

SELECT
CONCAT(single_deal.currency, ':',
CAST(single_deal.id AS CHAR) COALESCE(CAST(single_company.id AS CHAR), 'unassigned') 'total' )
CAST(single_deal.id AS CHAR) COALESCE(CAST(single_company.id AS CHAR), 'unassigned') 'total' AS group_key,
CONCAT(single_deal.currency, ' · ',
single_deal.name COALESCE(single_company.name, 'Unassigned') 'Total' )
single_deal.name COALESCE(single_company.name, 'Unassigned') 'Total' AS group_label,
single_deal.currency 'count' AS unit,
SUM(single_deal.value) COUNT(*) AS value FROM ( SELECT d.id, d.name, d.value, d.currency, d.company_id FROM deal d JOIN deal_person single_link ON single_link.deal_id = d.id JOIN person single_person ON single_person.id = single_link.person_id AND single_person.suspended_at IS NULL AND single_person.archived_at IS NULL WHERE d.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} AND d.won IS NULL AND d.risk_excluded = FALSE
GROUP BY d.id, d.name, d.value, d.currency, d.company_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT single_link.person_id) = 1 ) single_deal LEFT JOIN company single_company ON single_company.id = single_deal.company_id AND ( single_company.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM company_share single_company_share JOIN workspace single_company_viewer ON single_company_viewer.id = single_company_share.workspace_id AND single_company_viewer.id = #{query.workspaceId} JOIN workspace single_company_owner ON single_company_owner.id = single_company.workspace_id AND single_company_owner.org_id = single_company_viewer.org_id WHERE single_company_share.company_id = single_company.id AND single_company_share.workspace_id = #{query.workspaceId} ) ) AND single_company.archived_at IS NULL GROUP BY group_key, group_label, unit ORDER BY value DESC, group_label, group_key
